title: Okwukwe Dị n'Aka Ocheeze
intro: A na-anwale ụfọdụ mkpụrụ obi ọ bụghị site n'ọkụ ma ọ bụ idei mmiri, kama site na nrụgide dị nwayọ nke ibi n'ime obí eze aka ike. Onye a guzoro n'akụkụ onye ọchịchị nke kwuru na ọ bụ chi karịa ndị ha, mana ọ rapaara n'okwukwe n'otu ezi Chineke ahụ na nzuzo. Mgbe achọpụtara nraranye ha, ahụhụ bịara - mana nkwa Chineke mere otu a. Ị nwere ike ịkọ onye nke a bụ?
clues: Ebi m n'okpuru ụlọ onye ọchịchị kacha ike n'ala m, n'ọnọdụ mmadụ ole na ole pụrụ ichetụ n'echiche.
Di m ma ọ bụ nwunye m guzoro n'ihu ndị mmadụ wee kpọọ onwe ya chi — mana obi m dịịrị otu ezi Onyenwe anyị.
Ekpere m ekpere n'olu dị ala n'ime nzuzo, na-atụ egwu ntaramahụhụ nke ga-abịara ndị niile na-enupụrụ di m ma ọ bụ nwunye m isi.
Mgbe e kpughere okwukwe m, e jidere m ma taa m ahụhụ — mana ire m ekwughị okwu ọ bụla nke ekweghị ekwe.
Awụsara m obi m nye Onyenwe m, na-arịọ maka ụlọ na Paradaịs, n'ebe dị anya na ihe ọjọọ ọ bụla.
Abụ m Asiya bint Muzahim — nwunye Fero nke megidere Mozis na Harọn.

identity.label: Ònye ka m bụ?
options: Asiya bint Muzahim (Nwunye Fero)
Hawa (Eve), nwanyị mbụ
Sarah, nwunye mbụ nke Ibrahim
Hega, nne Ishmael
Nne Meri (nwunye Imran)

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ịtachi obi n'ahụhụ maka ịjụ ịjụ okwukwe
Ịdị ndụ n'ime afọ azụ ukwu
Ịrụ nnukwu ụgbọ iji gbanahụ idei mmiri
Ịtụba n'ime ọkụ na-ere ọkụ
Ịgba àmà nke kewara nnukwu oké osimiri
trial.answer: Ịtachi obi n'ahụhụ maka ịjụ ịjụ okwukwe

location.label: Isi Ihe
options: Ụlọ e wuru maka ha na Paradaịs
Mkpanaka nke gbanwere ghọọ agwọ
Ụgbọ nke nwere ụzọ abụọ nke ihe niile e kere eke
Nwa ehi ọlaedo nke mba na-efe ofufe
E ji akụ aka merie dike ukwu
location.answer: Ụlọ e wuru maka ha na Paradaịs

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: A na-asọpụrụ ya site n'ibi na Paradaịs n'akụkụ ndị ezi omume
Mmiri kpuchiri ya na ndị agha ha
Ọ gbara ya ọkụ mana Chineke zọpụtara ya site na ntinye aka ya
E loro ya site n'aka nnukwu ihe e kere eke wee tụfuo ya n'ụsọ osimiri
Aghọọla onye kacha baa ọgaranya n'oge ha
outcome.answer: A na-asọpụrụ ya site n'ibi na Paradaịs n'akụkụ ndị ezi omume

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
